name: argus-linux-e2e-demo
description: ARGUS Fleet/Caldera E2E demo profile. Runs a single Linux pipe-to-shell primitive (curl | sh) against the soc-endpoint-1 sandcat agent to trip the [ARGUS] Linux pipe-to-shell (T1059.004) rule via osquery_manager telemetry.

attack_commands.notes: Primitive will fail to resolve attacker.local but osquery captures the cmdline, which is what the rule scores on.
